items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: I know I asked Tatum several times to show me certain things... But Art got me the gig with Stepin Fetchit.

ctx.x: He was a working man already. That’s great. And the atmosphere in New York at that time was pretty happening, right?

Oh, New York was great because especially for a youngster trying to learn the music business. Because the older guys would show you everything, you know, whatever you asked, you couldn’t do it but they’d show you. I know I asked Tatum several times to show me certain things, he’d say, “Oh, Gerry,” [scats]. I’d say thanks.
